{
  "pattern_id": "P-LIT-DISTRIBUTED-CACHE",
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "rationale": "The workflow uses conda to set up an environment based on '.github/conda_ci.yml'. Implementing a cache for the conda environment/package downloads can reduce the time spent in the 'setup-miniconda' and 'conda install' steps. I will use actions/cache@v4 to cache the conda package cache and environment directory, keyed by the runner OS and the hash of the conda configuration file.",
  "workflow_yaml": "on:
  pull_request: null
  push: null
  workflow_dispatch: null

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  condaBuild:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4.4.0
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Cache Conda
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/miniconda3/pkgs
            ~/.conda
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-conda-${{ hashFiles('.github/conda_ci.yml', '.github/condarc.yml') }}
      - uses: conda-incubator/setup-miniconda@fc2d68f6413eb2d87b895e92f8584b5b94a10167 # v3.3.0
        with:
          environment-file: .github/conda_ci.yml
          condarc-file: .github/condarc.yml
          auto-activate-base: true
      - name: Install conda-build in base environment
        run: conda install -n base -c conda-forge conda-build
      - name: buildSnakePipes
        uses: uibcdf/action-build-and-upload-conda-packages@b06165145a25b9c8bcb2d2b24682ad0d8e494ce7 # v1.4.0
        with:
          meta_yaml_dir: conda-recipe
          python-version: 3.11
          upload: false
"
}
